paragraphs.text: Mongoose is a green creature type used for cards that depict a species of slender, ferret-like carnivores that feed on rodents , birds , and eggs .

The first creature to bear the type was Blurred Mongoose from Invasion , though Karoo Meerkat from Mirage was issued errata to become a subtype Mongoose as well (instead of Meerkat ). The third and last printed card was Nimble Mongoose from Odyssey . Mongooses are especially noted for their ability to kill cobras and other venomous snakes , but this hasn't been translated into the cards yet. They usually have shroud , and in one instance protection from blue .
Aspect of Mongoose is an Aura from Time Spiral that grants Shroud .
Mongoose reappeared after twenty-four years in Universes Beyond 's Avatar: The Last Airbender .
An Unknown Event introduced the Nim Mongoose playtest card which was a zombie mongoose as a reference to the Nim .
Mongooses could be found in various parts of Dominaria .
Llanowar was home to the Blurred Mongoose, which would hunt snakes near rivers.
Jamuraa was home to the Karoo Meerkats, who were very vigilant against strangers.
Otaria was home to the Nimble Mongooses, which were said to be faster than a cobra's bite.
Avatar: The Last Airbender featured the moongoose lizard , which were giant reptilian creatures who were domesticated by the Fire Nation.
